# New Britain Fire Department

> The official website of the New Britain Fire Department providing emergency services information, leadership directory, station locations, and community fire safety resources.

The New Britain Fire Department serves the New Britain, Connecticut community with comprehensive fire suppression, emergency response, and public safety programs. The department maintains multiple stations and operates a youth explorer program while being led by a professional command structure.

## Key Topics

- New Britain Fire Department
- Emergency Services
- Fire Suppression
- Community Protection
- Fire Safety
- Fire Chiefs
- Fire Stations
- Leadership Directory
- Fire Explorers
- Organizational Structure
- Local Government
- Deputy Chiefs
- Contact Information
- Fire Marshal

## Core Services & Overview

- [Home - New Britain Fire Department](https://fd.newbritainct.gov): New Britain Fire Department homepage with emergency services and fire safety information
- [Fire Stations](https://fd.newbritainct.gov/fire-stations): New Britain Fire Department station locations and directory including Station 1 and 2

## Leadership & Organization

- [Fire Chiefs](https://fd.newbritainct.gov/fire-chiefs): Leadership directory featuring Fire Chiefs Raul Ortiz, Donald King, Scott Morgan, Paul Walsh

## Community Programs

- [Explorers](https://fd.newbritainct.gov/explorers): New Britain Fire Explorers youth program for ages 14-20 affiliated with Boy Scouts

## Department History

- [History](https://fd.newbritainct.gov/history): New Britain Fire Department history covering organizational evolution and service statistics
